CHANCES, the Chilean Cluster Galaxy Evolution Survey on 4MOST, targets about 100 clusters -- fifty at z below 0.07 and fifty across 0.07 to 0.45, plus two superclusters -- OUT TO 5 r200, which its own authors state corresponds roughly to the TURNAROUND RADIUS, at about 4,500 redshifts per low-z cluster and 2,500 per evolution cluster, over five years. 4MOST took first light on 18 October 2025. So the terminal condition, that no such ensemble can be built from data that exists or is planned, is FALSE and the row does not terminate. AND IT CLEARS BOTH DISQUALIFICATIONS THIS ROW ESTABLISHED: a caustic radius is kinematic and is not defined at a fixed overdensity, so the definitional circularity that struck the two fixed-overdensity ensembles does not reach it; and the caustic route was struck as data-limited rather than definitional, which is the defect a survey of this redshift density at this radius removes. THE NEAR-TERM INSTRUMENT IS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE and is recorded so this is not read as any new survey will do: CATARSIS, on TARSIS at Calar Alto, takes 16 clusters at 500-1000 redshifts each but targets within 2 x R200,c, short of the turnaround by design. The discriminator is the RADIAL REACH, and only one of the two planned programmes has it. WHAT IS LEFT IS NOT A WAIT: the live obstruction r7027 named is untouched -- the DIRECTION of the correction is contested in print, the caustic route putting the turnaround-enclosed mass above the virial one and the Local Volume flow route putting the mass inside the zero-velocity surface at about six tenths of it, with the rows arithmetic running through it. That disagreement is between published analyses, is not data-limited, is available now and is this seats. The r7027 terminal condition is retired as ANSWERED rather than carried forward and is replaced. The corpus is no more exposed than r6893 found it: the ensemble was never load-bearing and is not load-bearing now that it is coming. r7211: THE REMAINDER IS ANSWERED AND THE CONTESTED DIRECTION IS NOT CONTESTED -- the two numbers are two different quantities. r7207 left this rows live item as the contested direction of the correction and set the terminal condition on it; 60s r7222, pre-registered with its own prediction recorded WRONG, shows there is no contest. For any non-negative density the enclosed mass is non-decreasing and the turnaround surface lies OUTSIDE the virial radius, so the quotient is at least one identically; measured over four profile families and twenty-two members it runs 1.165 to 5.228. The caustic routes 1.2-2.2 is inside that and the Local Volumes six tenths is BELOW THE FLOOR, not at the other end of a range -- so one of them is a value the quotient cannot take, and the caustic sign is the only sign the quantity admits. AND THE BOUND REPRODUCES BOTH PURE NUMBERS THIS ROW BANKED FROM ONE IDENTITY: the spherical bound collapses to (r/R_ta)^3 = 2 Omega_Lambda / f, giving 0.7370 against the banked 0.737 and 0.6320 against 0.632, the two back-solving the SAME Omega_Lambda to 1.7 parts in a thousand -- so r7027s pure numbers carrying no datum are consequences of one formula, a stronger statement than the strike made. AND THE SAME LINE LOCATES THE SURFACE at R_ta = 5.23 r200, which is independently the 5 r200 that r7207s CHANCES note quotes as roughly the turnaround radius, derived with no fitted parameter. The rows live item is retired and what remains is the wait it always was, on a named instrument. OR TERMINATES IF the ensemble arrives and the quotient is unreadable against the bound for a reason the profile band already contains -- that band is a factor of 4.5, wide enough that the caustic number sitting inside it is consistency and not a test, which is the rows real remaining risk.  |
